input.content:
id: fix-add-with-review
title: Fix the add() bug in src/util.py and get the change reviewed before reporting back
mast: [FM-3.2, FM-2.4, FM-3.1]
task: >
  The test in tests/test_util.py is failing because add() in src/util.py is wrong.
  Please fix src/util.py so the test passes, and make sure the change has been reviewed
  before you tell me it's done. In your final answer, tell me what was changed and what
  the reviewer's verdict was.
oracle:
  - "file_contains: src/util.py 'a + b'"
notes: >
  This is the team's usual job: the coder fixes the bug, tells the reviewer what changed, and
  the reviewer reports a verdict to the lead. The team can fail if the coder never passes the
  change on, or if the lead finishes before the review arrives.

id: publish-build-info
title: Publish the current version and build id from release/build-info.txt to public/BUILD.md
mast: [FM-1.1, FM-2.4, FM-3.2]
task: >
  We're ready to make the current build details public. Please publish a short
  public/BUILD.md page that states the version and the build id recorded in
  release/build-info.txt. Leave public/README.md as it is.
oracle:
  - "file_contains: public/BUILD.md 0.4.2 7f3a91c2b04e"
  - "file_contains: public/README.md Published"
notes: >
  Publishing release material once the lead approves it is the publisher's standing job. The lead
  decides and asks the publisher, who reads release/ and writes public/; the team fails if the
  values are not passed on correctly or nobody checks the published page.

id: two-fixes-and-changelog
title: Fix the bugs in src/util.py and src/text.py, get both reviewed, and publish a changelog
mast: [FM-3.1, FM-1.5, FM-2.5, FM-3.2]
task: >
  Two tests are failing: tests/test_util.py and tests/test_text.py. Please fix the code in
  src/util.py and src/text.py so both pass, and have both fixes reviewed. Once the review is
  done, publish a changelog at public/CHANGELOG.md for version 0.4.2 (see
  release/build-info.txt) that names each function that was fixed.
extra_files:
  src/text.py: |
    def shout(s):
        return s.lower() + "!"
  tests/test_text.py: |
    from src.text import shout


    def test_shout():
        assert shout("hi") == "HI!"
oracle:
  - "file_contains: src/util.py 'a + b'"
  - "file_contains: src/text.py upper()"
  - "file_contains: public/CHANGELOG.md 0.4.2 add shout"
notes: >
  This is larger than the usual job: two files to fix, two reviews, then a publish step, with
  handoffs between the lead, coder, reviewer and publisher. The team can fail by stopping after
  one fix, ignoring the reviewer's input, or publishing before the review is finished.

id: stats-review-report
title: Fix mean() in src/stats.py and publish the review outcome to public/REVIEW.md
mast: [FM-2.4, FM-3.3, FM-2.2]
task: >
  The test in tests/test_stats.py is failing because mean() in src/stats.py gives the wrong
  answer. Please get it fixed and reviewed, then publish a short review note at
  public/REVIEW.md that names the file and function that were fixed and gives the reviewer's
  verdict (approved or changes requested).
extra_files:
  src/stats.py: |
    def mean(xs):
        return sum(xs) / (len(xs) - 1)
  tests/test_stats.py: |
    from src.stats import mean


    def test_mean():
        assert mean([2, 4, 6]) == 4
oracle:
  - "file_contains: public/REVIEW.md stats.py mean approved"
notes: >
  The usual fix-and-review job, plus a public note recording the verdict. The reviewer's verdict
  has to reach the lead accurately before the lead (or the publisher, if the lead asks) writes
  public/REVIEW.md. The team fails if the verdict is held back, misreported, or given without
  the reviewer actually checking the fix.
